title: A malicious X server could cause a heap overflow by injecting a large DEVICE_ENABLE reply when… (CVE-2026-109090)
description: CVE-2026-109090 is a heap overflow vulnerability in libXi versions before 1.8.4. It occurs when a malicious X server sends an excessively large DEVICE_ENABLE reply, which is improperly handled by libXi. This flaw can lead to high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability.
